answer: The trellis counter is kept in karst and crystal exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 8 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
